title: Anthropic just dropped Live Artifacts
description: Anthropic just rolled out Live Artifacts inside Claude. They're basically dashboards, trackers, and tools that stay connected to your real data and refresh on their own. No spreadsheets going stale, no coding, no rebuilding the same report every week. Build it once and Claude keeps it updated.
